YAML to JSON Converter

Parse YAML (maps, lists, nested indentation, scalars, quoted strings) into JSON with clear error messages.

Practical YAML subset: maps, lists, nesting by indentation, scalars, quoted strings, comments, and simple inline [arrays] / {maps}. Not supported: anchors & aliases, multi-line | / > blocks, custom tags.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste your YAML into the input box.
  2. Click Convert to JSON — the parsed result appears formatted.
  3. Copy the JSON or download it as a .json file.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which YAML features are supported?

Indentation-based maps and lists, nesting, strings, numbers, booleans, null, quoted scalars, comments, and simple inline [arrays] and {maps}.

Does it support the full YAML spec?

No: anchors/aliases, multi-line block scalars (| and >), tags, or complex keys. The FAQ below explains the limits.

How are indentation errors reported?

Tabs are rejected (per the YAML spec) and every error names the offending line number.
